primary_sources.title: Hatcher, Notes on Basic 3-Manifold Topology, retained version
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem1.9 inclusion-minimal JSJ torus collection unique up to isotopy; Proposition1.12 Seifert irreducibility; Proposition1.13 essential vertical annuli/tori; Lemmas1.14-1.15 boundary-fibre uniqueness with ALL product/Klein exceptions. Source terminal disk(2,2) is INCLUDED and no fibre uniqueness is asserted there. Target three pieces have negative orbifold Euler and no exceptions.

primary_sources.title: Waldhausen, On irreducible 3-manifolds which are sufficiently large, Ann Math87(1968),56-88
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem6.1 exact boundary-relative covering conclusion. Both exteriors proved irreducible/boundary-irreducible, target aspherical and sufficiently large, full stable peripheral isomorphism realized as map of pairs with boundary homeomorphism, one source torus boundary excludes exceptional product over closed orientable surface, pi1 isomorphism forces covering degree1. No recognition from H1 or unmarked group.
